applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: BITs with 80+ countries including the United States (1995), United Kingdom (1991), Germany (1990), France, Italy, Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal, Sweden, Denmark, Switzerland, Japan, South Korea, China, India, Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Peru; DTAs with numerous jurisdictions; various FTAs including EU agreements and Mercosur

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo (as amended by Ley 7/2021 and EU AML Directives 5/6); UBO Register under Royal Decree 304/2014 and subsequent updates

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of Identity (Passport or National ID Card)
Articles of Association or Founding Documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority in country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC SDN, UN sanctions, and domestic Spanish list screening using compliant tools per AMLD requirements

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Mandatory Spanish language and Latin alphabet; foreign names adapted to Spanish orthography without additional transliteration
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Administrative appeal before Registro Mercantil within one month of rejection; subsequent judicial review via contentious-administrative jurisdiction if denied

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for SL entities if address functions as official registered office for service of process and notifications; accepted for non-regulated wholesale distribution activities
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (under 5% for standard SL wholesale entities absent regulatory triggers)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for compliance due diligence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Hague Apostille Authority or Spanish Consulate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff or prevailing market benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 of 2 July, approving the consolidated Capital Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital); Articles 19-22 (deed and incorporation), Article 62 (minimum SL capital), Article 63 (paid-up capital), Articles 102-103 (registered office), and Articles 196-201 (appointment and powers of directors).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central for corporate name certification and the competent Provincial Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) for company inscription; the corporate act is formalized before a Spanish public notary.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public incorporation deed (Escritura de Constitución) inscribed in the Commercial Register (Inscripción en el Registro Mercantil), combined with the provisional tax documentation filed with the Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: A standard Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada requires share capital of at least €3,000, fully subscribed and paid in cash or in-kind at incorporation. The founders may alternatively use the 'Sociedad Limitada de Formación Sucesiva' regime, permitting capital below €3,000, subject to a compulsory legal reserve, restricted distributions, and strict insolvency rules until the €3,000 threshold is reached. Cash contributions must be deposited in the notary's account or a bank statement attached to the deed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS PASSED AT THE ORGANIZATIONAL FIRST BOARD MEETING. 1. Incorporation. The founders ratify the subscription and approve the deeds signed today. 2. Shareholding. Each quota is fully paid in cash, and the directors acknowledge receipt. 3. Registered Office. The registered office is established at the address stated in the deed, subjecting the company to the corresponding Commercial Registry. 4. Officers. The undersigned appoint [Name] as sole Administrator and [Name] as alternate Administrator. 5. Powers. The Administrator receives full corporate representation, banking, tax, and administrative authority. 6. Taxfilings. The Administrator is instructed to obtain the provisional NIF, register the company with the Social Security, and commence statutory activity filings. Approved unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain negative company-name certificate from the Central Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central electronic portal (through notary or online application)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal request for a 'Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social', listing three preferred names in order of priority. The certificate confirms no conflicting registered corporate name and authorizes the requested name for incorporation.
required_dossiers: Completed application form
Three proposed corporate names in descending priority
Identification of promoters and their tax identification numbers
Payment of applicable tariff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If one or more names conflict, the Registry issues a negative result; the notary or applicant immediately submits a new application with revised name alternatives, keeping the other filings pending.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the public incorporation deed before a Spanish notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Notary (Notario) selected by the incorporators
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founders or their legal representatives appear before the notary, approve the memorandum and articles of association (estatutos), set the exact capital subscription, and sign the deed. The notary verifies identity, legal capacity, and the bank statement showing paid-up capital.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate
Valid passports or national IDs and NIE numbers of founders
Memorandum and draft articles of association
Bank certificate or statement evidencing deposit of capital
Statement of appointment of initial directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects defects in the deed, a corrective amendment (escriptura de subsanación) is signed before the same or another notary; if translations or legalization are missing, the documents are apostilled or sworn-translated before re-execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for the provisional Spanish tax identification number (NIF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), provincial or online delegated tax office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 15 days after the deed is executed, submit the signed deed and incorporators' identification in Form 036 ('Solicitud de CIF provisional' or 'NIF definitivo' depending on registration timing). AEAT issues a provisional CIF pending final registration in the Commercial Registry.
required_dossiers: First copy of the notarized incorporation deed
Original and photocopy of directors' NIE/passport
Form 036 completed and signed
Negative name certificate and draft articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT requests additional documentation or identifies a mismatch, resubmit the corrected deed or Form 036 within the grace period; provisional NIF is normally reissued within 48 hours once the query is resolved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the incorporated SL in the Provincial Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) corresponding to the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Furnish the original notarized deed and the supporting tax form to the Provincial Registry. The Registrar examines the legality of the deed and, if approved, records the company and its opening balance sheet page. Registration is the effective date of legal personality.
required_dossiers: Original notarized incorporation deed (first copy)
Certified copy of negative name certificate
Form 036 with AEAT stamp or proof of provisional NIF
Directors' identification and acceptance statements
Bank certificate of paid-up capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry files a defect report (calificación negativa), the notary or counsel resolves the defect by amending the deed or obtaining the necessary waiver, then re-presents the deed to the registry within the statutory reaggregation period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the obligatory formation notice and register the employer with Social Security
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil (BORME) and Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary or Registry transmits the incorporation summary to BORME for publication. In parallel, file Form SE022 ('Solicitud de inscripción de empresa') with TGSS to obtain the employer account code (código de cuenta de cotización), and submit the company to the Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores if relevant.
required_dossiers: Certificate of registration from the Provincial Commercial Registry
Form SE022 signed by legal representative
Power of attorney if filing through representative
Identity documents of the signatory
Proof of appointment of administrator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If BORME publication is delayed or rejected, the Registry may initiate publication within 48 hours once the inscription is complete. If TGSS rejects the employer application, correct the data in the Social Security electronic system and resubmit the SE022 form with the supporting deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Activate tax census, accounting books, and municipal activity authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: AEAT, Provincial Commercial Registry, and corresponding City Council (Ayuntamiento)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the final Form 036 to update tax addresses, choose the applicable corporate tax regime, and request any optional activities. Order and legalize the mandatory accounting books at the Commercial Registry, and complete the municipal 'Licencia de Apertura' application if the company will occupy physical premises.
required_dossiers: Final Form 036 filed with AEAT
Notarial deed and registration certificate
Inventory of physical premises, lease or ownership title
Municipal operation description and floor plans
Copy of directors' identification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal licensing authority issues an unfavorable technical report, prepare corrected technical plans, fire-safety certificates, or environmental conditions; the applicant may appeal the denial to the municipal technical secretary or amend the project to satisfy the required safety measures.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Industry, Trade and Tourism (Dirección General de Industria y de la Pequeña y Mediana Empresa) in coordination with the regional industrial council; the local City Council (Ayuntamiento) issues the activity license.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia Municipal de Apertura y Funcionamiento for wholesale storage and distribution of Portland clinker and hydraulic cement

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition and Demographic Challenge - Subdirección General de Evaluación Ambiental (or the regional environmental authority where devolved)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Simplified environmental assessment (Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental Simplificada) for storage facilities with silo capacity above 50 tonnes or located near sensitive receptors; small wholesale depots without grinding, kiln operation or clinker treatment may be registered as a non-classified activity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process wastewater is generated; stormwater and washout from cement handling areas must be neutralized to pH 6-9 with suspended solids below 35 mg/L before municipal sewer release; silo fill-vent particulate emissions must remain below 10 mg/Nm³ using sealed cartridge filters; packaging, spill residues and oversized clinker rejects are classified as non-hazardous construction and demolition waste and must be handled through authorized haulers; ambient dust suppression at unloading points must meet the local atmospheric emission ordinance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The facility must obtain a fire-protection compliance certificate under the Technical Building Code (CTE DB-SI) including standpipe, extinguishers, exit signage, and fire-fighting access routes; a structural certificate under CTE DB-SE covering silo wind loads, seismic actions, soil bearing capacity and racking stability; an occupational health and safety inspection under Law 31/1995 (Prevención de Riesgos Laborales) including workplace ventilation, lighting, emergency planning, and handling protocols for cement dust and manual loading equipment; and a pre-opening municipal inspection verifying compliance with the approved plans and occupancy permit.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); official portal: www.agenciatributaria.es. Single national tax authority for corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades), VAT (IVA/Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido), customs and excise. Territorial delegations (Delegaciones de la AEAT) handle taxpayer registration; the Central Electronic Office (Sede Electrónica) hosts the census filings, SII submission services and the e-administration of export procedures.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Spanish SL obtains its statutory tax identification number (NIF - Número de Identificación Fiscal), which simultaneously acts as the VAT identification number (NIF-IVA) for EU and customs purposes. Procedure: (1) Before or immediately after execution of the public deed of incorporation (escritura de constitución) before a Spanish notary, request a provisional NIF from the AEAT using the pre-incorporation procedure; (2) Register the company in the Registro Mercantil within one month of deed execution; (3) File the census declaration (alta en el Censo de Empresarios) on form 036/037 in the AEAT e-office, using the digital certificate of the legal representative (administrador), declaring the registered office, effective management place, activity code CNAE 4663, expected turnover and the commencement date; (4) AEAT assigns the definitive NIF and records the entity in the IVA Census and the Official Chamber (directorio) of the VIES system; (5) Foreign parent entities are fully permitted as shareholders and must appoint a Spanish tax agent/fiscal representative (representante fiscal) if they are non-EU residents and carry out any taxable transactions (Art. 45 LGT and Art. 164 VAT Law); non-EU corporate shareholders do not require a Spanish NIE, but their Spanish subsidiary must independently hold the NIF.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The SL is a separate resident juridical person subject to Spanish Corporate Income Tax (25% standard rate, plus no territorial surcharge) on worldwide income. No pass-through or check-the-box election is available for an SL; the company itself is the taxpayer. Non-resident shareholders are not taxed on undistributed profits and may claim treaty relief or the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive on qualifying dividends.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or pass-through election exists under Spanish law. The available statutory elections and regimes are: (i) fiscal consolidation (tax group) election under Art. 55 et seq. LIS, requiring 75% direct/indirect Spanish group ownership; (ii) tax-neutral merger/demerger/asset contribution election under Arts. 76-80 LIS; (iii) participation exemption opt-in for dividends/qualifying capital gains under Art. 21 LIS (5% holding, 1-year minimum holding period); (iv) option to apply the special intra-community triangulation simplification (Art. 26 VAT Law) for EU intermediary chains; (v) standard VAT monthly/quarterly filing election (monthly mandatory if SII applies; otherwise quarterly with optional monthly under the large-company regime); (vi) optional election under Art. 15 quater LIS to document the absence of hybrid mismatches, with automatic neutralization applicable (ATAD I) without elective scope.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido - IVA), Law 37/1992 implementing the EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC. No separate GST or sales and use tax; certain excise duties (Impuestos Especiales) may apply only to energy products, not to clinker.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general VAT registration threshold applies to goods wholesalers. Any entity habitually supplying goods in Spanish territory must register for IVA/ NIF-IVA before commencement of operations. De minimis limits exist only for the special simplified regime (Régimen Simplificado, purchase threshold EUR 250,000 and/or turnover threshold EUR 250,000) and the small-business regime (Régimen Especial de Pequeño Negocio, EUR 85,000), but these regimes do not exempt a B2B wholesale exporter from registration and are not applicable to the subject océanic wholesale activity.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Real-time fiscal clearance applies through the SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) for entities with turnover exceeding EUR 6,010,121.04: invoice records must be transmitted to AEAT in the SII XML schema over the AEAT REST API (HTTPS with X.509 digital certificate) within 4 calendar days for monthly declarants (8 days for quarterly filers). For all other operators, the Veri*FACTU regulation (RD 1007/2023) and the Crea y Crece Law (Law 18/2022) mandate compliant e-invoicing software that generates a per-invoice QR with a chained hash (encadenamiento) and provides an integrity certificate; deadlines applied progressively: software producers by 1 July 2025, large enterprises (turnover > EUR 8,000,000) receiving e-invoices by approximately late 2025/2026, and all other businesses by late 2026. Additionally, B2B e-invoicing is mandatory in Spain, requiring interoperable FacturaE XML records (EN 16931) signed with a qualified electronic certificate and stamped with the AEAT or platform digital trace. The SII is not a pre-clearance stamping system, but records must be accepted by AEAT in near real-time; rejected records trigger error correction within 10 days.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (export exemption under Art. 21.2 of the Spanish VAT Law) applies to the wholesale supply of Portland cement clinker (CN code 2523 10 00) exported to a third country (e.g., Latin American ports) provided that: (i) the goods are physically dispatched from the EU customs territory within 90 days of the date of dispatch/shipment; (ii) the exporter is the holder of an export customs declaration (DUA/MAU) and the goods have actually left the EU customs territory; (iii) the exporter retains the export documentation and proof of exit (MRN and the corresponding customs office stamp/electronic TR). The zero rating is also available for ancillary freight and handling services directly connected to the export. An intra-EU supply to a VAT-registered counterparty is exempt (not zero-rated export) under Art. 25 VAT Law and requires a valid EU VAT ID of the acquirer and a recapitulative statement on form 349.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA - Documento Único Administrativo, EU Single Administrative Document) with the MRN (Movement Reference Number), confirming export from a Spanish/any Spanish customs office and actual exit from the EU within 90 days; the DUA must identify CNAE/CN 2523 10 and the exporter's NIF.

Bill of Lading (Conocimiento de Embarque - ocean B/L, original or express release), evidencing the vessel, port of loading (e.g., Valencia, Bilbao, Barcelona), port of discharge and consignee; for bulk clinker, the mate's receipt and silo weight certificate are additionally required.

Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Ingreso de Divisas / Justificante de cobro de la exportación) issued by a Spanish financial institution evidencing receipt of the export proceeds in EUR/USD under Swift LC or Wire TT, corresponding to the invoice and DUA value.
Commercial invoice (Factura Comercial) complying with SII/Veri*FACTU format, stating the zero-rated nature and reference to Art. 21 of the VAT Law.
Insurance or contract of carriage (póliza de seguro / contrato de fletamento) linking the cargo to the export movement.
Packing list and weight certificate (lista de embarque y certificado de peso) for bulk clinker in the vessel's holds.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT customs and VAT audit divisions will verify the congruence between the export declaration, the B/L and the inward remittance. If the export is not completed within 90 days or the documentation is false/incomplete, the zero-rating is reversed and VAT is assessed at 21% on the supply, plus late-payment interest (interés de demora). Fraudulent or negligent misapplication may qualify as an infracción tributaria grave (serious infringement) under Arts. 191 and 201 LGT, with penalties from 50% to 150% of the tax under-declared; for intentional concealment in international structures, the penalty base can reach 150% and criminal tax evasion charges under Art. 305 Criminal Code apply if the amount defrauded exceeds EUR 120,000. Retrospective clawback (devolución compensatoria) of input VAT recovered in reliance on the zero-rating is executed together with the assessment and penalties. The statutory audit window is 4 years from the relevant tax period; however, in cases involving forged documents, the limitation period is 5 years and the criminal clawback period may be longer. To substantiate the 180-day FX repatriation benchmark, any inflow after 180 days is presumed suspect and AEAT may deny the inward remittance certificate evidence; in practice, if proceeds are not collected within 180 days, the exporter must recognize the receivable as in default and the zero-rating remains at risk unless the foreign seller can prove irrevocable documentary credit (Swift LC) and valid insurance. AEAT also enforces cross-border e-invoicing records and may request the full SII file and the raw FacturaE XML to verify the chain of custody of the export document bundle.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates under full capital and current account convertibility within the eurozone framework. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are unrestricted subject only to 19% dividend withholding tax and CRS/FATCA reporting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export receipts must be surrendered to a resident bank within 90 days of shipment. Mandatory conversion to euro at the Bank of Spain reference rate with no additional surrender ratio required beyond full repatriation for tax residency.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for licensed fintech EMI providers such as Wise Business or Revolut Business; legal constraints include mandatory maintenance of Spanish resident bank accounts for tax residency and full AML compliance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital onboarding and KYC permitted for standard SL entities via certified platforms; physical presence and in-person director interviews required for high-value accounts or complex structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ultimate beneficial owner certificate, corporate registry extract, and source-of-wealth documentation
Enhanced due diligence report, passport copies, proof of address, and compliance certifications

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code CAP or EQTY. Verification requires shareholder resolutions, subscription agreements, and bank reference letters. All transactions screened through correspondent networks with full AML controls.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements include SWIFT MT103 for TT wires and Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP 600. Disbursements require pre-shipment verification and post-shipment reconciliation with customs declarations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts Filing (Cuentas Anuales) with Registro Mercantil
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil Central / Provincial Mercantile Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the closing of the financial year; filing within one month after approval by the shareholders' meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of EUR 200 for each year of delay up to three years; penalties of EUR 1,200 and EUR 2,000 for unexplained failure; risk of company name blocking and inability to file subsequent deeds

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Tax Return (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) - Modelo 200
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months and twenty-five days after the end of the tax period; calendar-year entities due by 25 October
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of 10%-20% depending on delay; late payment interest from the day after the deadline; penalty for failure to file of the greater of EUR 150 or 50% of the tax amount due

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic-Industrial Registry Return (Censo de Empresarios, Profesionales y Retenedores) - annual confirmation via Modelo 036/037 updates
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Coincident with the Corporation Tax return filing calendar; any relevant changes to data must be filed within one month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of EUR 100 to EUR 500 for incorrect census data; EUR 1,000 for failure to file changes within time after prior warning

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Confirmation and non-financial entity registry update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (through the Single Electronic Portal of the Ministry of Justice); Registro de Titularidades Reales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No separate annual filing; update required within one month of any change in ultimate beneficial ownership; annual declaration integrated into the Annual Accounts filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to EUR 60,000 for serious infringement; fines up to EUR 600,000 for very serious repeated failures to disclose UBO information

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Declaration of Beneficial Owners for tax transparency (Modelo 232) when applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fiscal year-end within one month after filing the annual corporate income tax return, generally by the same filing deadline as Modelo 200
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Infringement penalty of EUR 300 per data item with a minimum of EUR 1,500; penalties up to EUR 50,000 for incomplete or incorrect information

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements of Foreign Branch / permanent establishment information (if PE applies) - not applicable for domestic SL unless acting as a PE
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil Central; Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Not applicable for a domestic Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada without permanent establishment

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit by an auditor registered with the ICAC if at least two of the following thresholds are met at the balance sheet date: total assets over EUR 2,850,000; net annual turnover over EUR 5,700,000; average number of employees over 50 during the financial year; entities meeting these thresholds for two consecutive years must appoint an auditor; otherwise audit exemption applies
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad) as adapted to the EU accounting directives; listed or larger groups may apply IFRS as endorsed by the EU; group consolidated statements must apply IFRS-EU

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL must maintain an internal register of ultimate beneficial owners and file beneficial ownership details through the Registro Mercantil electronic portal. The Annual Accounts / annual filing to the Registry implicitly confirms the UBO data at the balance sheet date; any alteration in the shareholding structure triggering a UBO change must be communicated within one month. For wholesale cement distribution entities with standard low-risk banking profile, annual confirmation is supported by the corporate tax return and the non-financial entity UBO declaration. The Registry may require an updated individualised UBO statement where a shareholding transfer exceeds 10% direct or indirect ownership.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro Registro de Socios for corporate member positions and Libro de Actas for director appointments)
Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owners (Libro Registro de Titularidades Reales)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - USD 1,200 per year for registered office and corporate agent and administration services in Spain
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - USD 12,000 per year depending on turnover, balance sheet complexity, and auditor firm size; exemption applies below the statutory thresholds

stage_6.statutory_headline_rate: 25% general rate (Art. 29.1 Ley 27/2014 LIS). Reduced 15% rate for newly created entities (first two tax periods with positive taxable base, qualifying as newly formed). Wholesale cement trading entity with no special reduced regime will fall under the 25% headline.
stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D&I tax credits (Art. 35 LIS, 25%+), 95% participation exemption for qualifying dividends/capital gains (Art. 21 LIS), 15% first-two-years rate for de novo S.L. companies, 3% digital? No. Deductions: allowances for impairment of trade receivables? But business is wholesale cement: standard amortization. No statutory tax holiday for this ISIC. Preferential deduction: 95% exemption (CIT) on qualifying foreign-source dividends and capital gains; tax credit for double taxation (Art. 31-32 LIS); 5% financial goodwill? No.
stage_6.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (Art. 26 LIS – no expiry). Per-year offset caps: 70% of pre-offset taxable base for net turnover < EUR 20M, 50% for EUR 20M–60M, 25% for > EUR 60M; first EUR 1M of negative tax bases always offsettable.
